request.query: partial derivative of a multivariate Hasse derivative is (d_j+1) times the next Hasse derivative

items.name: MvPolynomial.pderiv
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type v} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → σ → Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R)

items.name: MvPolynomial.pderiv_X_self
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ), (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) (MvPolynomial.X i) = 1

items.name: LaurentSeries.derivative_iterate
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V] (k : ℕ)
  (f : LaurentSeries V), (⇑(LaurentSeries.derivative R))^[k] f = k.factorial • (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) f

items.name: MvPolynomial.pderiv_def
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (i : σ),
  MvPolynomial.pderiv i = MvPolynomial.mkDerivation R (Pi.single i 1)

items.name: MvPolynomial.pderiv_monomial
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type v} {a : R} {s : σ →₀ ℕ} [inst : CommSemiring R] {i : σ},
  (MvPolynomial.pderiv i) ((MvPolynomial.monomial s) a) = (MvPolynomial.monomial (s - Finsupp.single i 1)) (a * ↑(s i))

items.name: MvPolynomial.mkDerivation
items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  (R : Type u_2) →
    {A : Type u_3} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] →
        [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid A] →
          [inst_2 : Module R A] →
            [inst_3 : Module (MvPolynomial σ R) A] →
              [IsScalarTower R (MvPolynomial σ R) A] → (σ → A) → Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) A

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv
items.type:
(R : Type u_2) →
  {V : Type u_3} →
    [inst : AddCommGroup V] → [inst_1 : Semiring R] → [inst_2 : Module R V] → ℕ → LaurentSeries V →ₗ[R] LaurentSeries V
